In this case, we have to use the identity  

$$
1+{cot}^{2}⁡x={csc}^{2}⁡x.
$$

Hence,

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{\pi /2}^{2\pi /3}\frac{1-{cot}^{4}⁡x}{{cot}^{2}⁡x-1}\,\text{d}x & ={\int }_{\pi /2}^{2\pi /3}\frac{(1-{cot}^{2}⁡x)(1+{cot}^{2}⁡x)}{{cot}^{2}⁡x-1}\,\text{d}x \\  & =-{\int }_{\pi /2}^{2\pi /3}(1+{cot}^{2}⁡x)\,\text{d}x \\  & =-{\int }_{\pi /2}^{2\pi /3}{csc}^{2}⁡x\,\text{d}x \\  & =\operatorname{cot}⁡x{|}_{\pi /2}^{2\pi /3} \\  & =\operatorname{cot}⁡\frac{2\pi }{3}-\operatorname{cot}⁡\frac{\pi }{2} \\  & =-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3}-0 \\  & =-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3}.\end{aligned}
$$
